name: k8s-debug-cluster-health
title: ship k8s-debug cluster_health v1.0
description: Cluster-level snapshot: nodes(Ready/NotReady) + node_conditions(DiskPressure/MemoryPressure/PIDPressure) + control_plane(apiserver/controller/scheduler/etcd) + kube_system pods + recent kube-system Warning events + versions. Designed as the first check before drilling into a namespace.
